description: Recent event logs of a contract on Base (chain 8453) from public RPC: block, time order, transaction hash, log index, event name (signature database), topics and data, with ERC-20/721 Transfer and Approval decoded to from/to/value. Look back up to 5,000 blocks (~2.8 h); optional event-signature filter. Internal transactions are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to scan, 1-5000 (default 500; Base makes a block every 2 s)

topic0.description: Optional event signature hash (0x + 64 hex) to keep only that event, e.g. the Transfer topic

name: crypto_basescan_contract_events
title: Crypto Basescan Contract Events
